bottom_line: The ratings mostly hold tonight: futures are up (S&P about +0.6% to +1.1%, Nasdaq 100 +1% to +2%) on Anthropic's record $83 IPO, and no new news hits the buy-side names. The one thing that matters is ANT's first trade: if it opens or slips below $83, that is the worldview's first named risk and a reason to wait.
what_changed: Anthropic priced the biggest IPO on record at $83 and lists today as ANT; Nasdaq 100 futures rose as much as 2% overnight, fading to about +1% by mid-morning ET (worldview risk 1: IPO below offer).
Wednesday's close was weak under the surface: S&P -0.2%, Dow -1.1%, and a six-day slide put MSCI ACWI near its lowest close since April.
Nvidia's after-hours pop after its beat disappeared at the open, a 'problem for the AI boom trade' (thesis: AI trade crowded at high rates).
No after-hours earnings on Nov 19 found for AI suppliers; jobless claims are due before the open.
